system.monsterType: Giant Animal (Common). A giant weasel is 8'-9' long and covered with a richly colored fur of white, gold, or brown. These quick and vicious predators hunt singly or in groups. Once they bite, they will hold on and suck blood, doing 2d4 points of damage each round until their prey is dead or until they are killed.
